Precision by species and confidence band, and by confidence threshold

Source: R/05_validation_metrics.R
pam_validation_metrics.Rd

Precision by species and confidence band, and by confidence threshold

Usage

pam_validation_metrics(val, pool, bands)

Arguments

val

Reviewed samples from pam_validation_import().

pool

Pool of all events from pam_validation_pool(); its cell sizes weight the threshold estimates, because sampling is stratified.

bands

Confidence band edges used when sampling.

Value

A list:

  • cells: per species x band: n_pool, n_reviewed, n_correct, n_incorrect, n_unsure, n_judged, precision and its 95% Wilson interval (unsure verdicts are excluded from precision).

  • thresholds: for each species (and "ALL") and each band edge, the estimated precision of all events at or above that confidence, weighted by band size, plus coverage (share of those events that sit in bands with at least one judged sample).

  • confusion: counts of predicted species vs the true species entered for incorrect verdicts.

Details

Recall, false negatives and F1 cannot be estimated from reviewing detections alone: they need a set of recordings in which every call has been annotated independently of the detector.
